The unknown \(x\) plus 6 equals 15. What is \(x\)? Calculate: \(15 - 6 = ?\)
What happens to equality when the same number is added to both sides of an equation?

choices.B: The left side increases, while the right side remains unchanged

displayedInputs.question: \(x - 4 = 9\). Add 4 to both sides. What is \(x\)? Calculate: \(9 + 4 = ?\)
$2x+5=17$. First calculate $17-5$, then consider $x$. What is $17-5$? Calculate: $17-5=?$
Buying 4 identical pencil cases cost 28 yuan. How many yuan does each cost? Calculate: $28\div4=?$
After 15 meters of a rope were used, 9 meters remained. How many meters long was the rope originally? Calculate: $15+9=?$
Traveling at 12 kilometers per hour for $x$ hours covers a total of 36 kilometers. What is $x$? Calculate: $36\div12=?$
What is the area, in square centimeters, of a parallelogram with a base of 9 centimeters and a height of 5 centimeters?
A parallelogram-shaped lawn has a base of 12 meters and a height of 6 meters. What is its area in square meters? Calculate: $12\times6=?$
What is the area, in square centimeters, of a triangle with a base of 6 centimeters and a height of 4 centimeters?
A triangular piece of fabric has a base of 10 centimeters and a height of 6 centimeters. What is its area in square centimeters? Calculate: $10\times6\div2=?$
What is the area, in square centimeters, of a trapezoid with an upper base of 3 centimeters, a lower base of 7 centimeters, and a height of 4 centimeters?
A trapezoidal field has an upper base of 4 meters, a lower base of 8 meters, and a height of 5 meters. What is its area in square meters? Calculate: $(4+8)\times5\div2=?$
A rectangle has an area of 24 square centimeters. A triangle with an area of 10 square centimeters is joined to its side. How many square centimeters is the total area? Calculate: \(24+10=?\)
What must you distinguish first in a tree-planting problem?

choices.A: Whether trees are planted at both ends or at only one end
choices.C: How thick the tree trunks are
